svg.title: RES-494 deadlift: plate force, bar-floor reaction and bar height
svg.desc: Summed foot force (green) and bar-floor reaction (orange) over system weight, and bar height above its floor position (blue, metres), with latent pre-tension onset and lift-off markers.
svg.text: RES-494 deadlift: plate force, bar-floor reaction and bar height
Synthetic only. Plate force rises while the bar is still on the floor; lift-off is the bar-floor contact opening.
